listing_title: Nuovo Bilocale | Piano Terra con Giardino - Residence al Lido Altanea — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / NUOVO BILOCALE | PIANO TERRA CON GIARDINO - RESIDENCE AL LIDO ALTANEA NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT Nuovo Bilocale | Piano Terra con Giardino - Residence al Lido Altanea PORTO SANTA MARGHERITA · CAORLE · VENEZIA PRICE €255,000 Photos (12) Floor plans (1) 1 / 12 FLOOR AREA 64 m² BEDROOMS 1 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Caorle! Just a few steps from the beach of Lido Altanea, a new concept of seaside living comes to life. This modern residence, nestled in a quiet and private setting less than 200 meters from the beach, is designed for those seeking the perfect balance between comfort, nature, and total relaxation. The project, currently under construction with completion expected by the end of 2027, offers refined newly built apartments: the perfect retreat for those dreaming of an elegant seaside residence that is efficient and designed to provide moments of pure well-being. This apartment, located on a corner among only four ground floor units, stands out for its maximum independence privilege, double private exposure and complete continuity between indoor and outdoor spaces. The heart of the home is the bright open space living area that opens directly onto a spacious covered terrace: a true outdoor lounge where you can enjoy moments of pure relaxation at any time of day. A hallway leads to the sleeping area which features a modern functional bathroom and a large master bedroom overlooking its own rear private garden: an intimate and quiet oasis where you can wake up every morning immersed in tranquility. Completing the amenities of this residence is a magnificent swimming pool exclusively for residents' use. Each unit is designed to ensure maximum energy savings and high residential comfort. Additionally, to make this two-room apartment truly yours, we collaborate with specialists in interior design who will guide you step by step in choosing tailored solutions and furnishings. The construction site is already available for visits by appointment: a unique opportunity to see the project up close and start imagining your new life by the sea. Contact us for availability information, floor plans, and specifications.
